lyricConnections.explanationJa: 親しい相手を誇らしく人に紹介する、という意味。
周りの心配事をいったん忘れ、目の前の時間を楽しもうと誘う表現。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Come meet my friends. I want to show you off.
sentences.displayHtml: Come meet my friends. I want to show you off.

conversation.japanese: 今夜の君、すごく素敵だよ。友達に会ってよ。みんなに君を紹介したいんだ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: That’s sweet, but I’m nervous about dancing.
sentences.displayHtml: That’s sweet, but I’m nervous about dancing.

conversation.japanese: うれしいけど、踊るのは緊張するな。変に見えたらどうしよう？

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Let’s forget about the world for a minute.
sentences.displayHtml: Let’s forget about the world for a minute.

sentences.text: Just listen to the music and dance with me.
sentences.displayHtml: Just listen to the music and dance with me.

conversation.japanese: 少しの間、周りのことは忘れようよ。音楽を聴いて、一緒に踊ろう。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Okay, but you have to lead.
sentences.displayHtml: Okay, but you have to lead.

sentences.text: I don’t know the first thing about dancing.
sentences.displayHtml: I don’t know the first thing about dancing.

conversation.japanese: わかった。でもリードしてね。ダンスのことは本当に何も分からないから。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Deal. There’s no right way to do it.
sentences.displayHtml: Deal. There’s no right way to do it.

sentences.text: Just move however you feel comfortable.
sentences.displayHtml: Just move however you feel comfortable.

conversation.japanese: もちろん。決まった踊り方なんてないよ。気楽に、好きなように動けばいい。

conversation.speaker: B
conversation.japanese: よし、踊るよ。今夜を一緒に楽しもう。
